site.evidence: POI text 'Tap 345 kV 1030 Morgan Creek to 76030 Gasconades Creek' locates a tap on the Morgan Creek-Gasconades Creek 345 kV line ~5 mi SW of Colorado City, TX; the site itself has NOT been anchored by any independent artifact (no FAA turbine coords, no CAD parcels, no news photos, no delivery pin). Lat/lon reflects the vicinity of the tap infrastructure, not a confirmed site footprint.

project_area.note: No abatement application, signed IA, or CAD parcel record was obtainable. Wind projects at 987 MW typically span 30,000-50,000+ acres of leased ranchland; no such land-control paper trail was found in this research.

llc_chain.evidence: TX Comptroller Active Franchise Taxpayers dataset (data.texas.gov 9cir-efmm, retrieved 2026-07-18) has 4 Spade Wind entities all at 500 W 2nd St, Austin TX 78701, chartered 2022-05-02: Spade Wind LLC (SOS 0804549070), Spade Wind I LLC (0804549043), Spade Wind II LLC (0804549049), Spade Wind III LLC (0804549059). No entity 'Zeus Spade Wind, LLC' exists. ERCOT queue project-name prefix 'Zeus' is a portfolio label, not the SPV.

TX Comptroller franchise dataset places 'Zeus Renewable Energy Development, LLC' (chartered 2022-04-27, 5 days before the Spade Wind LLCs) at the same address 500 W 2nd St Ste 1900, Austin TX 78701. Sibling SPVs at that suite include Mitchell Solar I/II/III (same county), Armstrong Solar, Houston County Solar, Rusk Solar — a portfolio pattern of county-name + resource + numbered variants consistent with a single early-stage developer spinning up SPVs to speculate on interconnection queue positions.

Zeus Renewable Energy Development LLC has no discoverable web presence: zeusrenewables.com / zeusrenewableenergy.com / zeus-re.com / zeusrenewable.com all NXDOMAIN; LinkedIn public 404; SEC EDGAR full-text 'Spade Wind' = 0 hits; no press releases, no financing announcement, no offtake announcement, no EPC named.
TX Comptroller: Spade BESS I/II/III LLCs chartered 2025-04-07, same Suite 1900 address. Confirms coordinated Zeus-portfolio wind+battery development in Mitchell County.

land_tenure.evidence: Mitchell County CAD 2025 certified appraisal roll (33,459 parcels, dated 2025-08, downloaded direct from mitchellcad.org and searched in full — sources/2026-07-18_mitchell-cad_2025-appraisal-roll.xlsx) contains ZERO parcels under Spade Wind LLC (any variant), Spade BESS LLC, Zeus Renewable Energy, or any owner at 500 W 2nd St Austin. Existing Mitchell County wind farms are all owned by RWE (Champion / Inadale / Roscoe) or Loraine Windpark LLC — no overlap with this project. Wind projects typically lease rather than purchase, so absence of purchased parcels is expected — but there is also no independent lease record, no abatement application listing tracts, and no IA exhibit describing land, so tenure cannot be characterized.

USGS US Wind Turbine Database (energy.usgs.gov/api/uswtdb) returns 206 built turbines in Mitchell County, all pre-existing (Roscoe 2008 x104, Loraine 2010 x68, Loraine II 2011 x32, Champion 2008, Inadale/Roscoe IV 2009). Zero turbines under Spade Wind or Zeus. Latest observation dates in the database extend to 2025-05-19 (Maxar) — the database has been maintained since triage and still shows no new Spade/Zeus turbines

Queue milestone data (per ERCOT GIS monthly report, verified against timeline.json): construction start REPORTED as 2025-08-01 by the developer. As of 2026-07 (~11 months later), this construction is NOT visible in imagery and NOT visible in the FAA/USGS turbine record. Reported construction claims are aspirational data supplied to ERCOT, not confirmed activity.
Wind projects of 987 MW typically install ~150-200 turbines strung across 20-40 km — a footprint far too large to miss at the 18-km grid resolution used

reasoning_evidence: As of 2026-06-01 (latest ERCOT GIS report), the project has NOT achieved FIS approval, has NOT signed an Interconnection Agreement (iaSigned=null), and has met NONE of the 6.9(1) milestones — it is at the FIS-Requested stage only (dated 2025-01-07). The reported COD is 2027-03-20, approximately 9 months from the imagery-observation date. For a wind project of this scale, the industry-typical gap between IA countersignature and COD is 24-36 months (siting, permitting, procurement, EPC mobilization, construction, commissioning). A COD in 9 months with no IA is contractually impossible for a wind project of this size.

Independent PUCT Interchange Filings Search (interchange.puc.texas.gov, 2026-07-18): searches by FilingParty for 'Spade Wind', 'Zeus Renewable', 'Zeus Spade', 'Spade BESS' all return 0 records. No IA has been publicly filed. This corroborates the queue-milestone absence of iaSigned.

Sentinel-2 imagery for 2026-07 shows no construction activity — no clearing, no grading, no turbine pads, no substation. The developer's reported construction-start date (2025-08-01) has passed without visible activity, showing the reported construction schedule is aspirational and not being executed.

Land control not established: Mitchell County CAD 2025 roll (33,459 parcels) contains zero Spade/Zeus/Suite-1900 owners; no abatement application on file with the county (JETI does not cover wind under HB 5; Ch.313 expired 2022-12-31, so no state-level abatement path exists for a 2024+ wind project). Land tenure remains 'unknown' at ~8 months to reported COD, another red flag.

The developer 'Zeus Renewable Energy Development, LLC' has NO web presence, NO press releases, NO announced financing, NO named EPC, NO PPA offtake, and no SEC/EDGAR filings. The sibling-SPV pattern (Mitchell Solar I/II/III, Armstrong Solar, Houston County Solar, Rusk Solar all chartered same day at the same suite) is signature of a queue-position-flipping speculator, not an execution-focused developer.

COD-drift history: reported COD 2027-03-20 has held steady across all 15 monthly snapshots (2025-04 through 2026-06) — apparent 'zero drift' is a triage red flag not a positive. A project that never updates its COD despite no progress is either not being actively managed or is holding an implausible date for optionality. Real developers file amendments; paper developers hold and hope.
External risk: federal permitting pause on wind (Trump DoD-review) affecting 54 TX projects — Spade Wind may be affected; effect is additive to the project's internal deficits.

Independent estimate: if this project moves at all, the earliest plausible COD is late 2029 — assuming FIS approval in 2026-H2, IA signing 2026-Q4/2027-Q1, financing/PPA 2027, EPC + procurement 2027-H2, construction 2028, commissioning 2029. This is contingent on the developer having capital, land control, offtake, and permits — none currently evidenced. More likely outcome: cancellation before IA.
